title: Descanso Beach Ocean Sports
specs: Must be atleast 7 years old and 55” tall.
Must be at least five years of age to participate.
Reminders Participants will get wet and MUST be able to swim.
Journey to Frog Rock: minimum 2 guests per booking.
Willow Cove Expedition: minimum 2 guests per booking.
Everything you bring with you must be packed out so bring extra trash bags.
Portable potty bags (WAG Bags) must be used and disposed of along with your trash.
A waiver/release of liability must be signed, and any emergency services will be at the renters’ expense.

gap: Standard Cancellation Policy All sales are final. No refunds. As a one time courtesy customers may rebook to a different tour / activity up to 48 hours prior to the activity start time by calling our call center at +1-800-619-1793. Flexible Cancellations: If you purchased Trip Cancellation Protection at the time of booking you can cancel and for any reason up to 24 hours before activity start time
blurb: Explore Catalina Island's natural beauty with kayaking, stand-up paddleboard, snorkeling and boat-in camping equipment rentals at Descanso Beach. We offer a variety of rental options to enhance your water adventures, including hourly and daily single or double kayak rentals, and stand-up paddleboards (SUP) rentals.
extraNote: If cancellation protection is added while booking, it allows for a full refund if the booking is cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the activity start time. · Close toed shoes required No skirts, dresses, belly shirts or bathing suits NON-REFUNDABLE OR EXCHANGEABLE WITHIN 24 HOURS OF PURCHASE. · NON-REFUNDABLE WITHIN 24 HOURS. · Keep in mind the weather and especially the winds while using kayaks for camping. · Flexible Cancellations: If you purchased Trip Cancellation Protection at the time of booking you can cancel and for any reason up to 24 hours before activity start time. · You will be issued a no questions asked refund minus processing fees.
